[P1] 青蛙弗洛格的成长故事
为处在性格形成关键期（3-6岁）
的孩子准备的一份心理自助礼物
图·文／（荷）马克斯·维尔修思
找到一个好朋友
学会珍惜友情
湖南少年儿童出版社
HUNAN JUVENILE & CHILDREN'S PUBLISHING HOUSE

[P2] 荣获
国际安徒生
插图奖
青蛙弗洛格的成长故事

图·文／（荷）马克斯·维尔修思
找到一个好朋友
—— 学会珍惜友情 ——

湖南少年儿童出版社
HUNAN JUVENILE & CHILDREN'S PUBLISHING HOUSE

[P3] 一个秋天的早上，天气好极了。青蛙弗洛格在树林里散步。他看到树上的树叶有的变成了金色，有的变成了橙色，还有的变成了棕色。“这个世界真是太美了！”弗洛格心里想着。

[P4] 在这一片美丽的色彩中，他突然发现好像有个什么
东西躺在草丛里。

[P5] 弗洛格走到跟前一看，原来那里躺着一个小棕熊。
他穿了件红毛衣，睁着一双又圆又亮的黑眼睛，
脸颊上还挂着一滴眼泪。

[P6] 弗洛格小心翼翼地把他捡起来，“啊，他真可爱！”弗洛格想，“我要把他带回家，让他跟我住在一起。”然后，弗洛格把小熊紧紧地搂在怀里，带着他的这个小小的新朋友朝家里走去。

[P7] 路上正巧遇上了小猪。

“你怀里抱着什么呀？”小猪问。
“我的新朋友。”弗洛格说，“是我在树林里找到的。”
“那你打算拿他怎么办呢？”小猪又问。
“他孤零零的，所以我打算让他跟我住在一起。”弗洛格说。

[P8] “让我来瞧瞧。”野兔跑过来说。野兔的耳朵最灵了。
“什么呀？这只是个泰迪熊，”野兔宣布说，“一个玩具，他甚至都不会说话！”
“我会教他说的。”弗洛格说。

[P9] 然后，弗洛格和小熊手牵着手回家了。小熊自己会走路，走得挺好的。

[P10] 开头的几天里，小熊一句话也不说。
可他吃得挺多，看来胃口很好。

[P11] 每天晚上睡觉之前，弗洛格会给小熊讲童话故事，还教他学几个词语，像“苹果”、“玫瑰”、“月亮”等等。

[P12] 那些天里，白天，他们一起玩足球和许多有趣的游戏。

[P13] 到了晚上，他们就一起画画，画了好多漂亮的图画。
就这样，他们度过了一段快乐的时光。渐渐地，渐渐地，小熊开始说话了。

[P14] 一天，弗洛格问他：‘小熊，你到底从哪儿来的？’
‘从那边。’小熊说，并用他的爪子指了指那个方向。

[P15] 野兔听到了他们的谈话，惊讶极了！
“他真的会说话吗？”野兔问。
“当然，”弗洛格自豪地回答，“我教他的！”
太不可思议了！每个人都跑来想亲耳听一听。
“小熊，你真的会说话吗？”大家都在问。
“说点什么吧！”大家安静下来，等待着。
沉默了一会儿，小熊开口说话了：“早上好！今天的天气真不错！”
大家都笑了。

[P16] cóng nà yǐ hòu , rén rén dōu chǒng zhe xiǎo xióng 。
从那以后，人人都宠着小熊。
yā zi ràng tā qí zài zì jǐ de bèi shang , dào chù qù wán 。
鸭子让他骑在自己的背上，到处去玩。

[P17] xiǎo zhū yòng mì fāng wèi xiǎo xióng kǎo zhì le tè shū de  xiǎo xióng bǐng gān
小猪用秘方为小熊烤制了特殊的“小熊饼干”。

[P18] 就连老鼠也很高兴地带着小熊一起去钓鱼。
他们都很喜爱小熊，小熊也爱上了他生活中的每一分钟。

[P19] 可是不寻常的一天却来临了。那天，小熊坐在一块大石头上眺望远处。

[P20] tā tū rán bù xiǎng zài wán shuǎ yě bù xiǎng zài hé rèn hé rén shuō huà
他突然不想再玩耍，也不想再和任何人说话。

[P21] 就这样，到了吃晚饭的时候，他也不想吃任何东西。
“小熊，”弗洛格问他，“你怎么了？你不舒服吗？生病了吗？”
“没有，”小熊轻轻地回答，“我也不知道自己怎么了。”

[P22] 第二天早上，小熊很早就起来了。
“你要去哪儿？”弗洛格不安地问。
“我要回去了，”小熊说，“回到我原来的地方，我属于
那里。”

[P23] 其他动物都跑来看发生了什么事。

“你要走吗？”大家都很震惊。
“去哪儿？”
“你认识路吗？”
“我会找到回去的路。”小熊说。
那么毫无疑问了，他真的要走了。

[P24] 大家都挺伤心的。他们为小熊准备了一个帆布背包，里面装满了食物和水，让他带着在路上吃。然后，小熊出发了，要回到他原来的地方。

[P25] 弗洛格的心都碎了。那天夜里，还有第二天的夜里，他躺在床上，却伤心得翻来覆去地睡不着。“小熊，我想你了。”他忍不住流下了眼泪。到后来，他哭着哭着就睡着了。再后来，有一天早上，很早很早，好像有一个温暖又柔软的小东西爬到床上，挨着他躺下了……

[P26] 弗洛格睁开眼睛。“小熊，”他欢呼着，“是你回来了吗？真的是你吗？”
“是的。”小熊说，“你是我最好的朋友，我属于这里，和你在一起。我知道我再也不会离开了。”
然后，弗洛格和小熊一起进入了甜蜜的梦乡。

[P27] 学会珍惜友情
能够找到一个真正的好朋友，是多么幸福的事情啊！珍惜这份友情，因为它会带给你一辈子的快乐！

想一想
1. 被弗洛格找到的小熊是只真正的小熊吗？
2. 弗洛格教会了小熊哪些事情？
3. 小熊为什么想离开？最后为什么又回来了？

试一试
你有好朋友吗？跟他（她）讲讲弗洛格和小熊的故事吧。讲完故事，相信你们会更好的。

full_text_en:
[P1] Froggy's Growth Story
A psychological self-help gift for children in the critical period of personality development (ages 3-6)
Illustrations & Text / (Netherlands) Max Velthuijs
Finding a Good Friend
Learning to Cherish Friendship
Hunan Juvenile & Children's Publishing House

[P2] Awarded
International Andersen
Illustration Award
Froggy's Growth Story

Illustrations & Text / (Netherlands) Max Velthuijs
Finding a Good Friend
—— Learning to Cherish Friendship ——

Hunan Juvenile & Children's Publishing House
HUNAN JUVENILE & CHILDREN'S PUBLISHING HOUSE

[P3] One autumn morning, the weather was wonderful. Frog Floppy was walking in the forest. He saw the leaves on the trees—some had turned golden, some orange, and some brown. "This world is truly beautiful!" Floppy thought to himself.

[P4] In this beautiful array of colors, he suddenly noticed something seemed to be lying in the grass.

[P5] Frog walked up close and saw that there was a little brown bear lying there.
He was wearing a red sweater, with a pair of round and bright black eyes,
and a single tear was still hanging on his cheek.

[P6] Frog carefully picked him up. "Ah, he's so cute!" Frog thought, "I'll take him home and let him live with me." Then, Frog hugged the little bear tightly and took his tiny new friend home.

[P7] On the way, he just happened to meet the little pig.

"What are you holding in your arms?" asked the little pig.
"My new friend," said Frog, "I found him in the forest."
"Then what are you going to do with him?" asked the little pig again.
"He's all alone, so I plan to let him live with me," said Frog.

[P8] "Let me take a look," the rabbit said as he ran over. The rabbit's ears were the most sensitive.
"What's this? It's just a teddy bear," the rabbit announced, "a toy, and he can't even talk!"
"I'll teach him to talk," Frog said.

[P9] Then, Frog and the little bear held hands and went home. The little bear could walk by himself, and he walked quite well.

[P10] In the first few days, the little bear didn't say a word.
But he ate a lot, so he must have a good appetite.

[P11] Every night before going to sleep, Frog would tell the little bear fairy tales and teach him a few words, like "apple," "rose," "moon," and so on.

[P12] Those days, during the daytime, they played football and many other fun games together.

[P13] In the evening, they would paint together, creating many beautiful pictures.
In this way, they spent a happy time. Gradually, gradually, the little bear began to speak.

[P14] One day, Frog asked him: 'Bear, where exactly did you come from?'
'From over there,' the bear said, and pointed with his paw in that direction.

[P15] The rabbit heard their conversation and was very surprised!
"Does he really speak?" the rabbit asked.
"Of course," Frog replied proudly, "I taught him!"
It was unbelievable! Everyone ran over to hear with their own ears.
"Bear, do you really speak?" everyone asked.
"Say something!" Everyone quieted down and waited.
After a moment of silence, the bear spoke: "Good morning! The weather is really nice today!"
Everyone laughed.

[P16] From then on, everyone doted on the little bear.
The duck let him ride on his back and went everywhere to play.

[P17] xiǎo zhū yòng mì fāng wèi xiǎo xióng kǎo zhì le tè shū de  xiǎo xióng bǐng gān
Pig used a secret recipe to bake special "Bear Cookies" for the little bear.

[P18] Even the mouse was very happy to take the little bear fishing with him.
They all loved the little bear, and the little bear also fell in love with every minute of his life.

[P19] But an unusual day arrived. That day, the little bear sat on a big stone, gazing into the distance.

[P20] tā tū rán bù xiǎng zài wán shuǎ yě bù xiǎng zài hé rèn hé rén shuō huà
He suddenly didn't want to play anymore, and didn't want to talk to anyone anymore.

[P21] Like this, when it was time for dinner, he didn't want to eat anything.
"Bear," Frog asked him, "What's wrong? Are you feeling unwell? Are you sick?"
"No," the bear answered softly, "I don't know what's wrong with me."

[P22] The next morning, the little bear got up very early.
"Where are you going?" Frog asked anxiously.
"I'm going back," the bear said, "to where I came from. I belong
there."

[P23] The other animals all ran over to see what had happened.

"Are you leaving?" Everyone was shocked.
"Where are you going?"
"Do you know the way?"
"I'll find my way back," said the little bear.
So there was no doubt about it—he was really leaving.

[P24] Everyone was quite sad. They prepared a canvas backpack for the little bear, filled it with food and water, and let him take it along the way. Then, the little bear set off, to return to his original place.

[P25] Frog's heart was broken. That night, and the next night too, he lay in bed, unable to sleep, turning over and over with sadness. "Little Bear, I miss you," he couldn't help but cry. Later, he cried himself to sleep. Then, one morning, very early, very early, it seemed as if a warm and soft little thing crawled onto the bed and lay down beside him...

[P26] Frog opened his eyes. "Bear," he cried, "have you come back? Is it really you?"
"Yes," said Bear. "You are my best friend. I belong here, with you. I know I will never leave again."
Then, Frog and Bear drifted into a sweet dream together.

[P27] Learning to Cherish Friendship
It's such a happy thing to find a true good friend! Cherish this friendship, because it will bring you happiness for a lifetime!

Think About It
1. Was the bear found by Frog a real bear?
2. What did Frog teach the bear?
3. Why did the bear want to leave? And why did he come back in the end?

Try It
Do you have a good friend? Tell him or her the story of Frog and the bear. After telling the story, you'll be even better friends.
